visualAssets.caption: Video explainer and interactive architecture simulation: DG32-LITE Architecture Narrated Explainer Film. Narration transcript: DG32-LITE is Deepgrid Semi's motor-control chip, and it makes one argument: hardware lockstep safety no longer needs an automotive-class microcontroller. Two RISC-V cores check each other on every write, inside a nine-by-nine millimetre package. First silicon rides the September 2026 multi-project shuttle, so every figure you will see is a design value, verified in simulation and timing analysis. Here is the whole case in brief. Narration transcript: DG32-2DOM is the attention variant of Deepgrid Semi's DG32-LITE motor-control chip. Every figure here is a post-route, simulated or analytic value, and each one is labelled. Here is the answer on one slide. DG32-2DOM is DG32-LITE plus an attention engine, not a new core.
